mapper.sql: id, alarm_no, device_id, device_name, param_key, param_name, actual_value, threshold_value, alarm_level, message, status, trigger_time, handler, handle_time, handle_measure
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (alarm_no, device_id, device_name, param_key, param_name, actual_value, threshold_value, alarm_level, message, status, trigger_time) VALUES (#{alarmNo}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{paramKey}, #{paramName}, #{actualValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{alarmLevel}, #{message}, #{status}, #{triggerTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET status = 'HANDLED', handler = #{handler}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, handle_measure = #{handleMeasure} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'UNHANDLED'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM alarm
ORDER BY trigger_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM alarm WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT MAX(alarm_no) FROM alarm WHERE alarm_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
